weeks.title: Course Overview, the 2026 FM Landscape, and AI-Native Engineering
weeks.goal: Understand what you will build (a small foundation model, released publicly), set up the full toolchain, and self-select honestly.
weeks.title_ko: 과목 소개, 2026 FM 지형도, 그리고 AI-Native 엔지니어링
weeks.goal_ko: 이번 학기에 만들 것(공개 배포하는 작은 foundation model)을 이해하고, 전체 toolchain을 설정하며, 수강 적합성을 스스로 솔직하게 판단합니다.

concept.topic: What this course produces: walk through OlmoEarth-Nano (1.4M params) and Presto (~400K) as proof that real EO pretraining fits Colab-scale compute; show the capstone endpoint (HF Hub release + model card + eval table).
concept.topic_ko: 이 과목이 만들어내는 것: OlmoEarth-Nano(1.4M params)와 Presto(~400K)를 훑으며 실제 EO pretraining이 Colab 규모 compute에 들어간다는 증거 확인 · capstone의 최종 도착점(HF Hub 릴리스 + model card + eval 표) 소개

concept.topic: The 2026 landscape in one pass: three generations of geospatial FMs (MAE-era → sensor-agnostic multimodal → global embedding fields like AlphaEarth/TESSERA); ML weather is operational (ECMWF AIFS since Feb 2025, NOAA AIGFS Jan 2026, Google WeatherNext 2) — the frontier is now probabilistic skill, obs-direct pipelines, and honest evaluation.
concept.topic_ko: 2026 지형도 한 번에 훑기: geospatial FM 3세대(MAE 시대 → sensor-agnostic 멀티모달 → AlphaEarth/TESSERA 같은 global embedding field) · ML 기상은 이미 현업 운영 단계(ECMWF AIFS는 2025년 2월부터, NOAA AIGFS 2026년 1월, Google WeatherNext 2) — 이제 프런티어는 확률적 skill, obs-direct 파이프라인, 정직한 평가

concept.topic: AI-agent-native engineering: what Claude Code/Codex are good at (scaffolding, refactors, sweeps) and bad at (silent numerical bugs, eval leakage); the verification discipline — you own every number; repo hygiene, commit-per-lab, research notes as first-class output.
concept.topic_ko: AI-agent-native 엔지니어링: Claude Code/Codex가 잘하는 것(scaffolding, refactor, sweep)과 못하는 것(조용한 수치 버그, eval leakage) · 검증 규율 — 모든 숫자는 본인 책임 · repo 위생, lab당 commit, 일급 산출물로서의 연구 노트

concept.topic: Logistics + honest self-selection: grading (10/30/60), site sign-in (id = student number), lead-pair sign-up. Explicit statement: "the two papers assigned today are due as tickets before Week 2 — if they take you more than ~6 hours and still feel opaque, this course will feel like that every week."
concept.topic_ko: 수업 운영 + 솔직한 수강 자가판단: 성적 비율(10/30/60), 사이트 로그인(id = 학번), lead-pair 신청 · 명시적 안내: "오늘 배정된 논문 2편은 Week 2 전까지 ticket으로 제출 — 6시간 넘게 걸리는데도 여전히 난해하게 느껴진다면, 이 과목은 매주 그런 느낌일 것"

concept.topic: Assigning the Week 1 readings in class: a guided walkthrough of Attention Is All You Need + ViT — what to look for, how to read them; both tickets (W1+W2) due Sun 9/6 13:00 on this site. First journal club is W2, instructor-moderated.
concept.topic_ko: Week 1 읽기 자료 수업 중 배정: Attention Is All You Need + ViT 가이드 워크스루 — 무엇을 봐야 하고 어떻게 읽는가 · ticket 2건(W1+W2)은 Sun 9/6 13:00까지 이 사이트에 제출 · 첫 journal club은 W2, 교수 진행

concept.topic_ko: W2 미리보기와 lab 시작

lab.task: AI Toolkit onboarding lab (after the diagnostic): set up the tools this course runs on and prove each one works. (1) VS Code + the Claude Code extension — install, sign in, and have it explain then modify a small script; (2) Codex in VS Code — same exercise, compare the two agents on one refactor; (3) Google Colab — GPU runtime on, torch.cuda.is_available() screenshot, save-a-copy discipline; (4) Kaggle — account + phone verification (unlocks the weekly free GPU quota), run one GPU notebook; (5) GitHub — account, SSH key, clone the course repo. Work through the linked official videos/docs at your own pace.
lab.task_ko: AI Toolkit 온보딩 lab(진단 퀴즈 후): 이 과목이 돌아가는 도구를 모두 설정하고 각각 작동함을 증명. (1) VS Code + Claude Code 확장 — 설치·로그인 후 작은 스크립트를 설명시키고 수정시키기; (2) VS Code의 Codex — 같은 연습, 하나의 refactor로 두 에이전트 비교; (3) Google Colab — GPU 런타임 켜기, torch.cuda.is_available() 스크린샷, 사본 저장 습관; (4) Kaggle — 계정 + 전화 인증(주간 무료 GPU quota 해제), GPU notebook 1개 실행; (5) GitHub — 계정, SSH key, 강의 repo clone. 링크된 공식 영상/문서를 각자 속도로 진행
lab.deliverable: AI Toolkit Report — 5-page PDF due Sun 9/6 23:59 on this site: for each tool, how you set it up, one real thing you made it do (screenshot), where it fits your weekly workflow, and one limitation you noticed.
lab.deliverable_ko: AI Toolkit Report — 5쪽 PDF, Sun 9/6 23:59까지 이 사이트에 제출: 도구별 설정 과정, 실제로 시켜본 작업 1가지(스크린샷), 주간 워크플로에서의 위치, 발견한 한계 1가지
lab.homework: Finish whatever didn't complete in class before the HW0 deadline (Mon 9/14, 23:59) — HW0 assumes all five tools work. HW0 is ungraded: it's how you check, hands-on, that you can run this course's weekly workflow. Stuck? Drop by S6 room 317 (HydroAI lab) and ask the researchers — they're expecting you.
lab.homework_ko: 수업에서 끝내지 못한 항목은 HW0 마감(9/14 월 23:59) 전까지 완료 — HW0는 다섯 도구가 모두 작동한다는 전제로 진행돼요. HW0는 채점하지 않아요: 이 수업의 한 주 워크플로를 내가 굴릴 수 있는지 직접 확인해 보는 과정이에요. 막히면 S6 317호(HydroAI 연구실)에 들러 연구원들에게 물어보세요 — 기다리고 있어요.

weeks.title: Leakage-Safe Evaluation Design (and the Fundamentals Recap)
weeks.goal: Design evaluations that survive spatial/temporal autocorrelation — the geoscience failure mode — with the optimization recipe compressed to a working recap.

weeks.goal_ko: 지구과학의 대표적 실패 요인인 공간·시간 자기상관을 견디는 평가를 설계하고, optimization 레시피를 실전용 복습으로 압축합니다.

concept.topic: Backprop as vector–Jacobian products; where activation memory goes (sets up gradient checkpointing in W12) — derived in full on the slides

concept.topic: The optimizer recipe every FM in this course uses: AdamW, LR warmup + cosine schedule, weight decay vs L2, gradient clipping; regularization and early stopping in one pass

concept.topic: HEADLINE — leakage in environmental data: spatial and temporal autocorrelation, why random splits lie, effective sample size under blocked CV; spatial-block and temporal-holdout design; train/test year separation as WeatherBench2 does it
concept.topic_ko: HEADLINE — 환경 데이터의 leakage: 공간·시간 autocorrelation, random split이 거짓말하는 이유, blocked CV에서의 유효 표본 크기 · spatial-block과 temporal-holdout 설계 · WeatherBench2 방식의 train/test 연도 분리

concept.topic: Designing a split a reviewer cannot reject: worked example on a global soil-moisture model (holdout by region, by year, by station network)
concept.topic_ko: 리뷰어가 기각할 수 없는 split 설계: 전 지구 soil-moisture 모델 실습 예제(지역별·연도별·관측망별 holdout)

lab.deliverable: Note 02 with sweep parallel-coordinates plot + a 'random split vs spatial split' table; one-paragraph leakage post-mortem.

weeks.title: Environmental Big Data and Cloud-Native Pipelines
weeks.goal: Fluently move satellite, reanalysis, and in-situ data through cloud-native formats; meet ERA5 and cos-latitude weighting.
weeks.goal_ko: 위성·재분석·현장 관측 데이터를 cloud-native 포맷으로 자유롭게 다루고, ERA5와 cos-latitude 가중을 처음 만납니다.

concept.topic: The data zoo: SMAP L3/L4, ERA5/MERRA-2 (reanalysis ≠ observation ≠ analysis), MODIS, GPM IMERG, HLS, Sentinel-1/2; spatial/temporal resolutions, latencies, error characteristics.
concept.topic_ko: 데이터 동물원: SMAP L3/L4, ERA5/MERRA-2(reanalysis ≠ observation ≠ analysis), MODIS, GPM IMERG, HLS, Sentinel-1/2 · 시공간 해상도, latency, 오차 특성

concept.topic: Cloud-native geospatial: COG, Zarr, STAC, chunking and why it dominates throughput; NASA Earthdata/earthaccess, Copernicus Data Space, Google/AWS public buckets, WeatherBench2's public ERA5 Zarr.
concept.topic_ko: Cloud-native geospatial: COG, Zarr, STAC, chunking과 그것이 throughput을 지배하는 이유 · NASA Earthdata/earthaccess, Copernicus Data Space, Google/AWS 공개 버킷, WeatherBench2의 공개 ERA5 Zarr

concept.topic: HEADLINE — ERA5 as a pretraining corpus: equiangular grids, pressure levels, why area weighting exists — derive the cos-lat weighted mean; anomalies vs climatology (sets up ACC in W11); regridding: conservative vs bilinear remapping and when each is correct.
concept.topic_ko: HEADLINE — pretraining corpus로서의 ERA5: 등각 격자, pressure level, 면적 가중이 존재하는 이유 — cos-lat weighted mean 직접 유도 · anomaly vs climatology(W11 ACC의 밑작업) · regridding: conservative vs bilinear remapping과 각각이 맞는 경우

concept.topic: Designing dataset objects for pretraining: chips, tiles, per-pixel time series; normalization statistics done right (per-band, train-set-only).
concept.topic_ko: pretraining용 dataset 객체 설계: chip, tile, per-pixel 시계열 · 제대로 된 normalization 통계(per-band, train-set-only)

concept.topic: Lab briefing: what the agent will scaffold vs what you must verify.
concept.topic_ko: lab 브리핑: 에이전트가 scaffold할 것 vs 직접 검증해야 할 것

lab.task: Agent-built ETL, two pipes: (a) open WeatherBench2's public ERA5 Zarr (5.625° subset) with xarray, compute a Z500 climatology and anomaly field, verify a cos-lat weighted global mean of T2m against a naive mean; (b) pull ~200 Sentinel-2 L2A chips (64×64, 4 bands) over South Korea via STAC (Earth Search on AWS) or HLS via earthaccess, with SCL-based cloud/QA filtering applied when selecting chips, and write a local Zarr/NPZ chip store with per-band stats.
lab.task_ko: 에이전트가 만드는 ETL, 파이프 2개: (a) WeatherBench2 공개 ERA5 Zarr(5.625° subset)를 xarray로 열어 Z500 climatology와 anomaly field 계산, T2m의 cos-lat weighted 전 지구 평균을 naive 평균과 대조 검증; (b) STAC(Earth Search on AWS) 또는 earthaccess의 HLS로 남한 지역 Sentinel-2 L2A chip ~200개(64×64, 4 band) 수집 — chip 선정 시 SCL 기반 구름/QA 필터링 적용 — 후 per-band 통계와 함께 로컬 Zarr/NPZ chip store 작성
lab.deliverable: Reusable data/ module + Note 03 (chip gallery, anomaly map, weighted-vs-naive mean table). This chip store is reused in W7.
lab.deliverable_ko: 재사용 가능한 data/ 모듈 + Note 03(chip 갤러리, anomaly 지도, weighted vs naive 평균 표) · 이 chip store는 W7에서 재사용

weeks.title: Sequence Models, Autoregressive Forecasting, and Rollout Stability
weeks.goal: LSTMs for hydrologic time series, and the autoregressive rollout mechanics that all ML weather models live or die by.
weeks.title_ko: 시퀀스 모델, Autoregressive 예측, Rollout 안정성
weeks.goal_ko: 수문 시계열을 위한 LSTM과, 모든 ML 기상 모델의 성패를 가르는 autoregressive rollout 메커니즘을 배웁니다.

concept.topic: RNN/LSTM/GRU mechanics; gradients through time; why LSTMs still rule rainfall–runoff (the CAMELS story, NSE/KGE metrics).
concept.topic_ko: RNN/LSTM/GRU 동작 원리 · 시간을 거슬러 흐르는 gradient · LSTM이 여전히 rainfall–runoff를 지배하는 이유(CAMELS 이야기, NSE/KGE metric)

concept.topic: Autoregressive forecasting as a discipline: teacher forcing vs free-running, exposure bias, error accumulation, multi-step (rollout) training curricula — exactly GraphCast's 1→12-step curriculum and Pangu's hierarchical 1/3/6/24-h models, previewed on 1-D problems.
concept.topic_ko: 규율로서의 autoregressive 예측: teacher forcing vs free-running, exposure bias, 오차 누적, multi-step(rollout) 학습 curriculum — 정확히 GraphCast의 1→12-step curriculum과 Pangu의 계층적 1/3/6/24-h 모델을 1-D 문제로 미리 체험

concept.topic: Stability and blurring: why MSE-trained autoregressive models regress to the mean at long lead times; first look at the double-penalty problem.
concept.topic_ko: 안정성과 blurring: MSE로 학습한 autoregressive 모델이 긴 lead time에서 평균으로 회귀하는 이유 · double-penalty 문제 첫 만남

concept.topic: Probabilistic outputs on time series: quantile loss, NLL heads — CRPS foreshadowed.

concept.topic_ko: lab 브리핑

lab.task: Train an LSTM on CAMELS-US forcing→streamflow for ~30 basins (NeuralHydrology or plain PyTorch). Key experiment: compare 1-step-ahead teacher-forced skill vs free-running 15-day rollout; plot NSE vs lead time; add a 3-step rollout loss and show the stability gain. Close with a 20-min ERA5 teaser: single-variable next-step prediction on the WeatherBench2 5.625° Zarr — the weather-direction seed.
